meta.name: story-review
meta.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；缺失/异常 agents 或 spawn 失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。触发方式：/story-review、/审查、「审查一下」「帮我审一下」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 多角度审查用户故事或代码，自动调度审查代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要团队协作审查故事或代码，希望自动获取多元反馈
copy.tagline_en: Review stories or code from multiple perspectives with automatic agent orchestration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need collaborative reviews of stories or code and want diverse feedback automatically

howto.what: Claude 变身为小说审查协调器:找结构/角色/文字/设定问题,给修改建议。full/lean 并行 spawn 审查 Agent,缺失或失败自动降级 solo;参考文件不可读用内置标准。输出统一 findings。
howto.when: 用户输入 /story-review、/审查,或说「审查一下」等指令时触发。

say.text: 审查一下第三章,主要看结构和节奏。
say.note: 默认 full 模式,spawn 全部 4 个 Agent。

say.text: /story-review lean 帮我审最近改的章节。
say.note: lean 只派结构 + 一致性两个 Agent。

say.text: 帮我审一下第200到300章,别忘了跨批伏笔。
say.note: 会读取追踪/伏笔.md,注入继承的开放项。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a story reviewer: finds structure/character/prose/setting issues and suggests fixes. Full/lean spawns agents in parallel; missing/failed agents fall back to solo. Unreadable refs use embedded rubric; unified findings output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user enters /story-review, /审查, or says “审查一下” and similar.

say_en.text: Review chapter 3, focusing on structure and pacing.
say_en.note: Default full mode spawns all 4 agents.

say_en.text: /story-review lean for the chapters I just edited.
say_en.note: Lean only spawns architect + consistency agents.

say_en.text: Review chapters 200 to 300, keep cross-batch foreshadowing hooks in mind.
say_en.note: Reads tracking notes; injects inherited open items.
